messages:
Maya: Quick sync — final landing copy & launch assets: three lanes (Hosted, Dedicated, Private), a 30m webinar, three social posts, and simple lead routing. Keep hero lines <12 words.

AJ: Two hero tones: PLG (fast) vs Trust (reliable). PLG for Hosted, Trust for Dedicated, Security for Private.

Noah: Hero drafts:
Hosted: "Ship LLM features in hours. SDKs, streaming, low lift."
Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity with predictable SLOs and burst options."
Private: "Private control plane with KMS and audit trails."

Lina: Webinar: 30m demo + benchmarks + migration checklist. Title: "Prototype → Production: Inference cost & latency" CTA: "Register — limited seats".

Maya: Social posts (short): please keep 1 line + CTA.

Noah: Social drafts:
- Hosted: "From prompt to prod in hours. Demo + Q&A. <link> #llmdev"
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput, predictable costs. See benchmarks. <link> #sre"
- Private: "Inference in your VPC — KMS & audit logs. <link> #security"

Lina: Routing rules (YAML) for ops — copyable:
```yaml
source: webinar_signup
utm_campaign: q2_launch
rules:
  - if: company_size >= 500
    route: AE_Enterprise
  - if: contains(tags, 'security') or contains(tags, 'compliance')
    route: AE_Enterprise
  - if: intent_score >= 7
    route: AE_SDR_Priority
  - else:
    route: SDR
send_notifications: [sales, marketing_ops]
```

Noah: Homepage benchmark blurbs (internal):
- "30% lower p95 latency at 2k tokens vs baseline"
- "2x effective throughput with smart batching"
- "Up to 40% unit-cost reduction after prefix/KV caching"
(legal review note: mark as internal benchmarks)

AJ: Action items: Noah finalize copy & social (EOD Tue). AJ build webinar page + SFDC wiring. Lina implement routing. Maya add mini-FAQ (model compat, quant profiles, support tiers).

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Launch copy review — Tue 09:30 PT (30m) — attendees: Maya, AJ, Noah, Lina

Maya: Thanks team. Closing thread, share assets in #assets when ready.

Noah: Uploaded drafts. Pinged.
